parts.tooltip: ma : Cont r a = (a ⟶ r) ⟶ r — a suspended computation waiting for its continuation; fixed when bind was applied
f : a ⟶ Cont r b — user code; given result a, builds the next continuation-based step; fixed when bind was applied
Builds the new continuation k' = \\a -> f a k.\nWhen k' receives a, it runs f a and hands it the ORIGINAL continuation k — this is the Cont-specific join.
Run the original computation, handing it k' instead of k. It decides if and when to call k' (once, many times, or never — callCC, early exit).

ports.tooltip: k : b ⟶ r — the final continuation: what to do with b once everything is done. Supplied each time the Cont is run.
r — the final answer of the whole computation; callCC can capture k to exit early
